meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎读 CSV/Parquet/JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、清洗和绘图;先探测数据量和内存,再决定放内存还是流式查询,重活会报行数和耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据集,或做分组聚合、时间序列、绘图时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按城市分组统计订单金额
say.note: 用 DuckDB 直接查文件并返回结果

say.text: 把这个 parquet 文件的日期列画成时间序列趋势图
say.note: 会先读可视化参考再出图

say.text: 这个数据集比内存大,请用流式方式查询
say.note: 改用流式查询或让 DuckDB 落盘

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON with resident engines (DuckDB, Polars, numpy): group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, and matplotlib charts. It probes size/RAM first and reports row counts and timing for heavy work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a CSV, Parquet or JSON dataset, or to do group-by aggregation, time series or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and group order amounts by city
say_en.note: DuckDB queries the file in place

say_en.text: Plot a time-series trend of the date column in this parquet file
This dataset is bigger than RAM - stream the query
